changes: Second low EPT directory in the existing private execution pool covers guest RAM above 1 GiB.
Device untyped tables retain the complete BootInfo descriptor capacity.
Skipped PCI address ranges use aligned child device untypeds retained only in root CSpace, without mapping skipped MMIO or delegating it to a driver.

negative_control.result: Intel root task refused startup at PCI device frame grant. Owned QEMU stopped after the explicit failure; Make returned 2.
negative_control.finding: BAR 0x7000000000 lies within the BootInfo device region starting 0x4000000000. The former page-at-a-time skip would require 50331648 dummy slots. Retaining all descriptors alone was insufficient.

proofs: Terminal teardown and zeroed pool reuse

limitations: This fixture does not establish full Debian recreation at 2 GiB. That managed gate is tracked separately.
Multi-vCPU support, CPU feature policy, dynamic resource admission and concurrent guest isolation remain outside this capacity step.
Canonical integration, required GitHub checks and remaining v0.4 acceptance are pending.
